annotations.title: Take a stay off its group

description: Takes a stay off its group (the undo of add_stay_to_group): its nights go back to its own folio, with tax if the group's exemption had removed it. rate: before (its rate before it joined) or keep (the rate it has now). First call without confirm: a preview, nothing changes; then call again with the same values, confirm true and preview_id. Owner only. Needs the owner's sign-in.

confirm.description: true to make the change shown in the preview

rate.description: Its rate before it joined, or the rate it has now

release_room.description: true to give back one held room of its type (the undo of grow_block), when no other stay needs it

name: remove_stay_from_group
title: Take a stay off its group
